outcome: severity of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)
maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: The participants were 164 pregnant women diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP).
finding: Low serum PLGF levels were significantly associated with the severity of HDP, adverse maternal complications, and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Significant associations were found between low PLGF levels and mode of delivery.
